art_direction: A tender final scene inside the same modest room: Wu Xie in the navy jacket is alone at a simple sink, quietly washing the SAME white bowl with cobalt-blue rim; chopsticks lie beside the sink. On the table in the background is a single open plain beer bottle and an empty unoccupied stool, as a quiet toast to an absent friend. A soft beam of cool evening light touches the washed bowl. His face is subdued but dignified; no visible second person, no ghost or hallucination, no fake text.
visible_description: 吴邪在空屋里清洗碗筷，记起潘子并默默送别。
poster_text: 他想，也许潘子早已想到，自己可能回不来了。
source_chapter: 《盗墓笔记8》大结局第七十四章（二）
adaptation_note: 小三爷到门口叫人、出发前回望和离开路上的画面为基于用户叙述的虚构改编；潘子是否预感归期为吴邪的猜测。
